m0-context.title: Load baseline context + verify handoff
m0-context.imperative: Read CREW_CONTEXT, the g4 handoff, analysis_refresh.md, pipeline.py, and the three downstream scripts + the manifest-loading primitives (run_sampled_runtime_comparison manifest resolution, assemble_trained_manifest_from_gold_artifacts, sampled_runtime_from_manifest/_from_config base_dir resolution, gold reports bundle_path). Verify the handoff is complete (task, intent, scope, exclusions, required evidence, test mode, stop conditions, return format). Attest c1.

postconditions.statement: crew context + handoff loaded; handoff complete; materialize keep/skip primitives confirmed by reading the loader (absolute module paths -> resolved directly)
postconditions.satisfied_by: Read CREW_CONTEXT, g4 handoff (complete: task/intent/scope/exclusions/evidence/test-mode/stop-conditions/return-format all present), analysis_refresh.md, pipeline.py, run_sampled_runtime_comparison.py, materialize_runtime_bundles.py, assemble_trained_sampled_runtime_manifest.py, fusion_training/_manifest.py, sampled_runtime.py, gold_cycle/reports.py. CONFIRMED materialize is SKIPPABLE: assemble writes ABSOLUTE period-local module paths from gold details bundle_path; sampled_runtime_from_config resolves absolute manifest_path directly (sampled_runtime.py:668), so comparison loads period modules without materialize.

m1-explicit-manifests-skip-materialize.title: Fix _run_downstream: explicit period manifests to comparison + skip global materialize
m1-explicit-manifests-skip-materialize.imperative: TDD. In src/evo_predictor/walkforward/pipeline.py::_run_downstream, (a) emit the trained (fusion) sampled-runtime manifest into the period's ISOLATED report dir via assemble_trained_sampled_runtime_manifest.py --output-manifest (period-local absolute module paths from gold details, which exist on disk); (b) drop the materialize_runtime_bundles.py call (it writes GLOBAL reports/evo + params/gold and relies on gold/fusion timestamp equality, neither valid for an isolated throwaway backtest; the comparison loads modules from the trained manifest's absolute period-local paths directly); (c) pass EXPLICIT --default-manifest <period gold sampled_runtime_manifest> and --trained-manifest <period fusion sampled_runtime_manifest> to run_sampled_runtime_comparison.py so it never auto-discovers the promoted gold from global reports/evo. Add a unit test that mocks subprocess.run + filesystem discovery and asserts the comparison argv carries the explicit period manifests and that no materialize step runs / no global path is targeted.

postconditions.statement: comparison argv includes --default-manifest and --trained-manifest pointing under the period report dir; trained manifest is assembled into the period report dir; materialize global step removed; no reports/evo or params/gold write in the downstream argv; unit test asserts this on a mocked subprocess; tests pass

constraints: Drive scripts via flags; do NOT change gold/fusion/comparison/assemble/materialize SCRIPT core logic
Do NOT touch G1/G2 code, scoring, gold defaults, or promoted params/gold artifacts
Period-isolated paths only; one canonical path; no global reports/evo or params/gold writes

m2-real-downstream-validation.title: One real cheap end-to-end downstream validation (no-training path)
m2-real-downstream-validation.imperative: Build a temp period work area whose report dir points at the EXISTING promoted-gold gold-cycle artifacts in reports/evo/ (gold_cycle_* summary/details/sampled_runtime_manifest + params/gold/uncertainty_calibration unc_cal_*). Drive the FIXED _run_downstream (or a thin harness calling SubprocessPipeline._run_downstream) for a single period restricted to 1-2 races via the period's eval_round_range, and show the comparison produces a *.trained.json under the period's sampled_runtime_backtests/ with per_race predictions (position_distribution) for those rounds, consuming the EXPLICIT period trained manifest (NOT the promoted gold by global discovery). Capture the run_config.default_manifest/trained_manifest from the comparison summary as proof they are the period paths. Keep it fast; do NOT run the full multi-hour walk-forward.

postconditions.statement: real fixed-downstream run over 1-2 races emits *.trained.json with per_race position_distribution for the requested rounds AND the comparison run_config records the explicit PERIOD trained/default manifest paths (not promoted-gold global discovery)
postconditions.satisfied_by: Real fixed _run_downstream ran fusion + assemble + 2-race sampled backtest (Australia, China) using promoted-gold artifacts as stand-in period. trained.json has per_race position_distribution for rounds [1,2]. Comparison run_config.default_manifest + trained_manifest are BOTH period-local (under temp pval/reports), trained is fusion_*, NOT promoted-gold global discovery. All 6 checks PASS.

constraints: No write to committed reports/evo or params/gold; everything under the temp period area
Read-only reuse of existing promoted-gold artifacts as the stand-in period inputs

payload.checks: ALL PASS (period-local default+trained, trained is fusion, not promoted-gold global, races Australia+China)
